# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_KINK_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A sharp change in ribbon slope (kink) coinciding with price crossing VWAP on high volume indicates institutional order flow exhaustion and imminent reversal. The ribbon slope kink captures accelerating/decelerating momentum shifts that pure price/VWAP interactions miss, while volume confirmation filters for institutional participation.

## Mechanism
Enter long when: 21 EMA slope turns from negative to positive (kink up) AND price crosses above VWAP with volume > 1.8x 20-bar average AND ribbon is bullish (8 EMA > 21 EMA). Enter short for inverse kink down with price below VWAP. Exit: Stop at opposite side of kink candle (below low of kink-up bar for long, above high of kink-down bar for short). Primary target: 2x ATR or VWAP reversion (whichever hits first) with runner trailing 10% above/below VWAP. Regime filters: VIX > 20, time 10:00-14:00 ET, ADX < 25 to avoid strong trend days.
